Q8442.reason: Salmond distinguished general jurisprudence (abstract principles of law) from particular jurisprudence (a specific legal system); Austin also drew a similar distinction, but Salmond is the usual attribution.

Q8444.reason: Gas gangrene from Clostridium perfringens, a gram-positive rod, is caused mainly by α-toxin (lecithinase).

Q8445.reason: Myeloid progenitors give rise to platelets (via megakaryocytes), whereas NK cells, T cells and lymphoid progenitors come from the lymphoid lineage.
